post.description:
OAuth2 compatible token login, get an access token for future requests.

This endpoint allows users to provide their own username and password to get a token.
The token must be included in the Authorization header for all subsequent requests.
The token is not stored in the server and must be managed by the client.

Args:
    username: The username provided by the user
    password: The password provided by the user

Returns:
    A dict with the following structure:
    {
        "access_token": str,  # The JWT token
        "token_type": str,    # Always "bearer"
        "expires_in": int,    # Seconds until token expiry
        "user": {             # User information extracted from the token
            "id": int,        # User ID
            "user_public_id": str,  # Public user ID
            "is_super_user": bool,  # Whether the user is a super user
            "is_active": bool       # Whether the user is active
        },
        "organizations": {    # Dictionary of organizations the user belongs to, keyed by org_public_id
            "org_public_id1": {
                "id": int,    # Organization ID
                "org_public_id": str,  # Public organization ID
                "roles": Dict[str, Dict],    # User's roles in this organization, keyed by role name
                "permissions": Dict[str, Dict],  # User's permissions in this organization, keyed by permission name
                "projects": Dict[str, Dict]   # Projects associated with this organization, keyed by project ID
            },
            "org_public_id2": {
                # Another organization...
            }
        }
    }

get.description:
Decode an enhanced token and return its contents.

This endpoint takes a token as input, decodes it, and extracts all information
directly from the token claims without making database queries.

Args:
    token: The JWT token to decode

Returns:
    EnhancedToken: The decoded token contents
